description: Independently recompute one LP capital account from authorized fund-level inputs and compare each statement line; never edit or distribute the statement.

routing.when_to_use: Use only when a fund LP capital-account statement must be independently tied to the fund NAV pack before distribution.
when_not_to_use: A different atomic task has its own skill
Requested output is an unapproved action or external effect
exclusion_rules: No system mutation or external communication
ambiguity_rules: Continue unaffected work and request only facts that materially change the result

required_inputs.name: scope_and_source_inputs
required_inputs.description: statement under test; authoritative NAV pack; prior statement ending capital; paid contributions; cash/in-kind distributions; fund P&L allocation basis/LP percentage; fees/expenses; waterfall/carry output and crystallization; commitment register; next-period statement if available; currency/rounding tolerance.

expected_outputs.name: task_work_product
expected_outputs.description: line-by-line statement vs recomputed values, difference, driver/evidence, carry/commitment checks, status flags and publisher handoff.

forbidden_actions: Mutation of company, fund, Odoo, accounting, payroll or source records
Payments, filings, signatures, publications, messages, approvals, trades or transaction commitments
Inventing current law, jurisdiction, entity/fund applicability or missing facts
verification_steps: 1. Confirm fund/LP scope, statement period, currency, actual NAV source-of-truth, and owner-supplied tolerance; the generated statement is the item under test. 2. Tie beginning capital to prior ending; separately verify paid capital calls, cash and in-kind distributions, allocated realized/unrealized P&L, management fee, fund expenses, and carry only when crystallized. 3. Recompute allocation from the documented commitment/ownership percentage effective for the period, noting transfers or equalization adjustments. 4. Recompute ending capital as beginning + contributions − distributions + allocated net income/loss − crystallized carry; show all components and source refs. 5. Compare every published line at the owner-approved tolerance; identify exact source input causing each delta. Do not adopt source default 0.01 if fund currency/rounding policy is unknown. 6. If next period exists, compare this ending capital to next beginning; sum all LP ending capital to fund NAV where the register/population supports it; compare commitment, unfunded, recallable figures to approved register. 7. Produce private exception report for publisher review; do not edit, sign, issue, or distribute statement.
Show formulas/denominators, evidence dates and assumptions; preserve unresolved conflicts.
Write only a requested private draft; no external effects.
completion_criteria: Conditional task scope is evidenced or limitations explicitly bound
Task method and calculation are reproducible from cited inputs
Owner decisions, open issues and source limitations are explicit

telemetry.retention_policy: opaque task/source IDs and hashes only
